claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one property and/or sub-property includes a timestamp and/or a measurement over a common period of time.

4. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one curation engine is operable to use artificial intelligence to automatically categorize the first parameter and the second parameter into the at least one property and/or sub-property based in part on historical accuracy of previous categorizations by an artificial intelligence engine.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one first sensor and the at least one second sensor are operable to measure heterogeneous, partially heterogeneous, or homogeneous machines.
6. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one computer processor is located on or in a machine, an edge device, at least one server, and/or a cloud.

8. The method of claim 7, further comprising conducting pattern recognition via the at least one curation engine to calculate a statistical probability that the at least one property and/or sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter are correlated.

9. The method of claim 7, further comprising categorizing via the at least one curation engine using artificial intelligence the at least one property and/or sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter based in part on historical accuracy of previous categorizations by the at least one curation engine.

10. The method of claim 7, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
11. The method of claim 7, further comprising curating the first parameter and the second parameter in real-time.
12. The method of claim 7, wherein the at least one property and/or sub-property includes a timestamp and/or a measurement over a common period of time.
13. The method of claim 7, wherein the at least one new data set includes an accuracy value for the at least one first sensor and the at least one second sensor.
14. The method of claim 7, wherein the first parameter and the second parameter are heterogeneous, partially heterogeneous, or homogeneous.
16. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one common property and/or common sub-property includes a timestamp and/or a measurement over a common period of time.

17. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
18. The system of claim 15, wherein the curation engine is operable to curate the first parameter and the second parameter in real-time.
19. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one first sensor and the at least one second sensor are operable to measure heterogeneous, partially heterogeneous, or homogeneous machines.

20. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one curation engine is operable to use an artificial intelligence engine to automatically categorize the first parameter and the second parameter into the at least one common property and/or common sub-property based in part on historical accuracy of previous categorizations by the at least one curation engine.
